segments.he: חַזַּן הַכְּנֶסֶת נוֹטֵל סֵפֶר תּוֹרָה: שְׁמַע מִינַּהּ חוֹלְקִין כָּבוֹד לְתַלְמִיד בִּמְקוֹם הָרַב! אָמַר אַבָּיֵי: כּוּלָּהּ מִשּׁוּם כְּבוֹדוֹ דְּכֹהֵן גָּדוֹל הִיא.
segments.en: § It was taught in the mishna: «The synagogue attendant takes a Torah scroll» and gives it to the head of the synagogue, who gives it to the deputy High Priest, who gives it to the High Priest. The Gemara suggests: «Learn from here» that «honor may be given to a student in the presence of the teacher.» Although the High Priest is considered everyone’s teacher and master, honor was nevertheless extended to other individuals without fear of impugning the High Priest’s honor. «Abaye said:» A proof may not be adduced from here because «the entire» process «is for the honor of the High Priest.» The passing of the Torah scroll to people of increasing importance demonstrates that the High Priest is considered the most important of all those present.
